summary: Frontend-only regression test of Product Edit page layout fix (max-w-5xl, flex flex-col, min-w-0). Verified across 4 viewport widths (1920/1440/1280/1024). No horizontal overflow at any width; all 5 header buttons (Back, Refresh, Change category, Delete, Save) are visible within the viewport. 3-column details grid renders correctly at md+; inputs constrained to their columns (SKU 314px wide). Images strip horizontally scrolls inside the card without breaking the container (966px width at 1920). Edit SKU + Save round-trip succeeds (button re-disables and footer Save changes button toggles). Back to products navigates back to grid (238 cards restored).
critical_code_review_comments: React hydration warning: In /app/frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.jsx around line 216, the <option> element inside the Category <select> contains a <span> child (likely inline JSX rendering c.group with formatting). HTML disallows <span> inside <option>; this triggers a console error on every render of the detail page. Suggest rendering plain text inside <option> (concatenate strings without wrapping in a span).

Sonner/toast selector: Save action worked (button state toggles from dirty→clean), but no toast element was discoverable with generic [class*='toast']/[role='status'] selectors — consider adding data-testid to toast container for reliable E2E assertions.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing in-memory mock products.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout regression for Product Edit page is fully fixed. Measured detail-page container bounding boxes: 1920→1024w, 1440→824w, 1280→664w, 1024→704w. Body scrollWidth == clientWidth at all widths (no overflow). All header buttons in view. Only observation: pre-existing hydration warning from <span> inside <option> in ProductDetail.jsx category select — not related to this fix, but worth cleaning up.
rca of the issue: Original bug caused by parent using CSS grid with a wide horizontally-scrolling image strip child; grid track expanded to intrinsic child size (~3470px) pushing buttons off-screen. Fix (already applied by main agent) switched container to flex flex-col + max-w-5xl + min-w-0, and the overflow-x-auto strip is now contained within its card. Verified fix holds across desktop breakpoints.
